project: RiceMix Promo — One Bowl of Rice
note: 35 秒版。原 70 秒砍掉一半：ACT1 从 9 镜压到 6 镜，ACT3 从 7 镜压到 5 镜，每镜 3 秒左右。中间留空段不再占用生成时长——它是你后期把实拍/屏幕录制插进来的位置。

format.style: chibi anime, 3-head-tall proportion, clean line art, soft cel shading, warm afternoon kitchen lighting

character.name: Da Fei Yu
character.description: blue long hair, whale tail, navy-and-white maid dress, chibi 3-head-tall, big blue eyes
character.rule: She speaks ONLY these four sounds. No other dialogue. Audience reads subtitles and expression.

shots.action: She lifts the lid, steam clears, revealing a pot of dry cracked rice. She pokes it — a solid thud.
shots.subtitle: Dinner. Finally.
shots.prompt: chibi anime, 3-head-tall proportion, blue-haired whale girl in navy maid dress, lifting a rice cooker lid, steam clearing to reveal dry cracked rice, she tilts her head with sparkling eyes, warm kitchen, close-up on the pot, soft cel shading

shots.action: She takes a big bite, chews twice, freezes. Eyes go wide. A tooth flies out. She covers her mouth, tears welling.
shots.subtitle: ...that is not rice. That is gravel.
shots.prompt: chibi anime, 3-head-tall, whale girl chewing then freezing in shock, eyes wide, one cartoon tooth flying out with a sparkle, hands covering mouth, teary eyes, comedic exaggeration, warm kitchen background

shots.action: She stares at the pot, puffs her cheeks, rolls up nonexistent sleeves, tail swishes. Determined glare.
shots.subtitle: Fine. I will do it myself.
shots.prompt: chibi anime, 3-head-tall, whale girl puffing cheeks with determined angry eyes, rolling up sleeves that do not exist, whale tail swishing, dramatic determined pose, warm kitchen, medium shot

shots.action: She washes rice, water blasting, grains flying. Then holds the pot under the tap and fills it more than half full, nodding proudly.
shots.subtitle: Water makes it soft. More water, more soft.
shots.prompt: chibi anime, 3-head-tall, whale girl washing rice under a tap with water splashing everywhere, rice grains flying, then filling the pot too full, nodding proudly, comedic, warm kitchen

shots.action: She presses the switch with a click, hands on hips, chin up, tail spinning like a propeller.
shots.subtitle: Ten minutes. Easy.
shots.prompt: chibi anime, 3-head-tall, whale girl pressing a rice cooker button, hands on hips, chin up proudly, whale tail spinning fast like a propeller, confident grin, warm kitchen, medium shot

shots.action: The pot bubbles over — white foam spills across the counter. She wipes with a cloth, making it worse. Then the camera cuts to the open lid: a pot of white porridge. Her face freezes. Background desaturates to grey, only she and the pot stay colored.
shots.subtitle: I made soup.
shots.prompt: chibi anime, 3-head-tall, whale girl staring blankly at a pot of white porridge, ladle drooping, background desaturated to grey while she remains in color, single spotlight, defeat, dramatic silence

segments.title: Insert Here
segments.note: 这一段不需要生成。把你自己的实拍 / 屏幕录制 / 机器运行画面接在这里。建议 10–15 秒：秤上的数字 036.8 → 078.2 → 110.4 → 120.4，泵启动，595 数码管亮起，有人按下 S2。

shots.action: Overhead shot: a scale, a pump, a small screen on a clean lit counter. She pours rice onto the platform.
shots.subtitle: This is RiceMix.
shots.prompt: chibi anime prop shot, overhead view, small electronic scale with digital display, peristaltic pump, tiny screen, matte black and brushed metal on wooden counter, warm pool of light, blue-haired whale girl hands pouring rice onto the platform

shots.action: Macro on the display: 120.0 g. She presses a button. Screen reads LOCKED. She nods.
shots.subtitle: It weighs the rice.
shots.prompt: chibi anime macro close-up, digital scale display reading 120.0 g, small finger pressing a button, screen switches to LOCKED, shallow depth of field, warm rim light on metal edge

shots.action: Ratio reads 1.20. She presses start. The pump hums. On screen the number climbs fast: 036.8 → 078.2 → 110.4. Her eyes track the digits.
shots.subtitle: Then it works out the water — 1.2 times the rice, to the gram.
shots.prompt: chibi anime close-up, small screen showing numbers counting up rapidly, whale girl eyes tracking digits with tense anticipation, pump humming in background, warm kitchen, shallow depth of field

shots.action: The number freezes at 120.4 g. The pump stops. Three last drops fall from the tube. Her eyes go wide with delight.
shots.subtitle: It stops 5 grams early — the tube keeps dripping.
shots.prompt: chibi anime extreme close-up, screen frozen at 120.4 g, pump stopped, three last water drops falling from a tube into a pot, whale girl eyes wide with joyful surprise, tiny sparkle effect

shots.action: She lifts the lid — steam bursts out, perfectly cooked glossy rice. She scoops a spoonful, it holds its shape. She hugs a big bowl, cheeks stuffed, eyes curved into happy crescents, tail swaying slowly. Logo fades in.
shots.subtitle: Read the number. Not your hand.
shots.prompt: chibi anime, 3-head-tall, whale girl lifting a rice cooker lid with steam bursting out, perfectly cooked glossy rice, then hugging a big steaming bowl with stuffed cheeks and happy crescent eyes, whale tail swaying, golden hour light, cozy warm ending, logo area bottom right

lines: One scoop of rice. One cup of water.

budget.tip: ACT1 的 6 镜每镜 3–4 秒，ACT3 的 5 镜每镜 2–4 秒。所有镜头都是单动作单表情，不要求镜头运动，AI 更容易一次出对，重roll 次数少。
